2014.text: Can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and its attack rolls have disadvantage.

2024.text: Can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and its attack rolls have disadvantage.

2014.text: Can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially with it.

2024.text: Can't attack the charmer or target it with damaging abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially with it.

2014.text: Can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

2024.text: Can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

2014.text: Levels add up. 1: disadvantage on ability checks. 2: speed halved. 3: disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. 4: hit point maximum halved. 5: speed 0. 6: death. A long rest removes one level.

2024.text: Levels add up (1-6). D20 tests are reduced by 2 times the level, speed by 1.5 m times the level. At level 6 the creature dies. A long rest removes one level.

2014.text: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source.

2024.text: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source.

2014.text: Speed becomes 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or it is moved out of the grappler's reach.

2024.text: Speed 0. Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler. The grappler can drag or carry it (extra movement cost).
Can't take any action, bonus action or reaction. Concentration is broken. Can't speak. Rolls initiative with disadvantage.

2014.text: Impossible to see without magic or a special sense; heavily obscured for hiding. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage, and its attack rolls have advantage.

2024.text: Surprise: advantage on initiative. Concealed: not affected by effects that need sight. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage, its attack rolls have advantage.

2014.text: Incapacitated, can't move or speak. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage; a hit from within 1.5 m is a critical hit.

2024.text: Incapacitated, speed 0. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage; a hit from within 1.5 m is a critical hit.

2014.text: Turned to stone: incapacitated, can't move or speak, unaware. Attack rolls against it have advantage. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Resistance to all damage, immune to poison and disease.

2024.text: Turned to stone: incapacitated, speed 0. Attack rolls against it have advantage. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Resistance to all damage, immune to the Poisoned condition.

2014.text: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

2024.text: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

2014.text: Can only crawl unless it stands up (half its speed). Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attacks against it have advantage within 1.5 m, otherwise disadvantage.

2024.text: Can only crawl or stand up (half its speed). Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attacks against it have advantage within 1.5 m, otherwise disadvantage.

2014.text: Speed 0. Attack rolls against it have advantage, its attack rolls have disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

2024.text: Speed 0. Attack rolls against it have advantage, its attack rolls have disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

2014.text: Incapacitated, can't move, can speak only falteringly. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage.

2024.text: Incapacitated. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage.

2014.text: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, unaware. Drops what it holds and falls prone. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage; a hit from within 1.5 m is a critical hit.

2024.text: Incapacitated, prone, speed 0, unaware. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage; a hit from within 1.5 m is a critical hit.

2014.text: Keeps a spell going. Taking damage: Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher) or the spell ends. A new concentration spell ends the old one.

2024.text: Keeps a spell going. Taking damage: Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage, max DC 30) or the spell ends. A new concentration spell ends the old one.

2014.text: At 0 hit points: death saving throw at the start of each turn. Three successes: stable. Three failures: dead.

2024.text: At 0 hit points: death saving throw at the start of each turn. Three successes: stable. Three failures: dead.
